timing_scope: Search includes first CUDA context initialization, allocations, transfers, evaluation, scoring, result hashing, and preview events. Total includes program construction and native/Gremlin holdout checks; excludes OS process startup. Same host and same release executable. CPU interpreter is single threaded; not a comparison against compiled native physics. No concurrent benchmark jobs.
